visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a young woman with long, dark hair and bangs, smiling broadly at the camera. She is wearing a grey off-the-shoulder knitted top. Bright, orange animated fire graphics flicker around the edges of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a screen recording of a smartphone. A news aggregator app shows headlines in Traditional Chinese featuring photos of the woman, suggesting public interest in her personal life. The woman's thumb is visible as she scrolls through the articles. (3) Returning to the woman, she is now gesturing with her hands while speaking energetically. Animated speed lines and impact symbols appear behind her to emphasize her facial expressions and movements. The background shows a domestic setting with stacked cardboard boxes. (4) A transition leads to a game of rock-paper-scissors. The woman's hand and a male hand enter from the sides against a dark background. Text overlays define the stakes of the game regarding flight seat classes. (5) After losing a round, the woman makes a playful, exaggerated sad face, and the video momentarily turns to a black-and-white filter with a drop-down sweat emoji icon above her head. (6) The screen displays a digital map showing a flight path from Taipei, Taiwan to Dubai, UAE, followed by a screen capture of a flight seat selection interface. The woman is seen in a small inset circle, looking at her laptop screen with a focused smile. (7) A sequence of shots showcases a luxurious apartment interior in Dubai. The living room features high ceilings, a modern dining table with elegant settings, and large windows with sheer curtains. The woman appears occasionally in an overlay, explaining the details. (8) The video concludes with the woman holding her hands near a large QR code displayed on the screen. She smiles and points towards a logo for a social media community, inviting viewers to join.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-energy electronic background music begins. The female speaker has a bright, high-pitched voice with fast articulation. A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX plays as the screen recording appears. (2) A clear 'ding' SFX punctuates the appearance of on-screen text. A male voice, slightly lower in pitch and calm, interacts with the female speaker. There is a continuous layer of melodic synth BGM under the conversation. (3) During the game sequence, rhythmic tapping SFX coincide with the hand gestures. When the woman loses, a comedic descending slide-whistle SFX is heard. The female speaker's arousal increases with high-pitched laughs. (4) The sound of rapid, light mechanical keyboard clicks and mouse scrolling is clearly audible as the flight booking is shown. The background music maintains a steady four-on-the-floor beat. (5) As the narration shifts to the Dubai apartment, the female voice becomes more melodic and explanatory. A 'sparkle' SFX plays when mentions of investment and wealth appear. The video concludes with a soft digital chime SFX.
